note:
Casey Jones runs 1:22 because the tape cut out mid-song, and nothing can extend it. Dave's Picks Volume 19 is the only release of this night, and the only two recordings catalogued anywhere on archive.org for the date — gd70-01-23.sbd.goodbear.88.sbeok.shnf and gd70-01-23.sbd.fixed.connor.18153.sbeok.shnf, both soundboards of the same lineage — do not contain the song at all; both run Mama Tried straight into Dire Wolf. So 1:22 is all that survives of it, and no audience tape exists to fill the gap.

Every other duration here is sound, which is what makes this a judgement rather than an obvious call: the setlist is known and thirteen of the fourteen stripes would be right. Jason's call, 2026-08-17, is that one width known to be wrong is enough to keep the show off the wall — a stripe is a claim about how long a song was, and this one would be a claim about where a tape stopped.

songs.title: That's It for the Other One
